english.title: Landlord of dwelling marketed / offered for let under domestic tenancy carry out letting activity without licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), marketed or offered for let under a domestic tenancy, without reasonable excuse, unlawfully

(A)_[arranged or conducted viewings with prospective tenants]_
(B)_[gathered evidence for the purpose of establishing the suitability of prospective tenants]_
(C)_[prepared, or arranged the preparation of, a tenancy agreement]_
(D)_[prepared, or arranged the preparation of, an inventory for the dwelling]_
(E)_[prepared, or arranged the preparation of, a schedule of condition for the dwelling]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
landlord of dwelling
marketed/offered for let under domestic tenancy
carry out letting activity
without being licensed under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It is a defence that the landlord is licensed to do so under Part 1 for the area in which the dwelling is located, the thing done is arranging for an authorised agent to do something on the landlord's behalf or an exception in section 8 applies.
